title: fix(showcase): the Status × Priority matrix subtitle names the estimated hours its cells hold
body:
Fixes #23931
Clause-②: no. The text of an example app's report changes. No export, type or accept set moves.

## What

The showcase report `showcase_status_priority_matrix` ("Status × Priority (Matrix)") showed the subtitle "Task counts cross-tabulated by status and priority." Its cells are `values: ['est_hours']`, which is a `sum` of `estimate_hours`. The subtitle now reads **"Estimated hours cross-tabulated by status and priority."** The measure, the dataset and the renderer are unchanged.

## Why hours and not counts

The subtitle was wrong. The measure was not.

- `est_hours` is declared in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/chart-gallery.dataset.ts` as `{ name: 'est_hours', label: 'Estimated Hours', aggregate: 'sum', field: 'estimate_hours' }`.
- The matrix has summed hours since the report was first written. At `e136adaaeb`, the commit that added the showcase, it had `columns: [{ field: 'estimate_hours', label: 'Hours', aggregate: 'sum' }]` next to the same "Task counts" text. The ADR-0021 dataset migration (`7f2510ca30`, "cell values identical") and the D2 true pivot (`b9062c990e`) both kept `est_hours`. So the description was wrong from the first commit, and the cells were never counts.
- A count matrix over the same two dimensions already exists. The Chart Gallery's `pivot_tasks` widget (`src/ui/dashboards/chart-gallery.dashboard.ts:93`) has `dimensions: ['status', 'priority'], values: ['task_count']`. Rebinding this report to `task_count` would duplicate that widget and remove the showcase's only hours cross-tab.
- The sibling reports already use this wording: "Estimated hours grouped by task status." and "Estimated hours by status, plotted as a bar chart."

## Translation bundle

There is nothing to update. Reports have no translation group: `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` maps the retired `reports` key to "reports have no translation group, omit them". The showcase bundle `src/system/translations/index.ts` has no report entry. A repo-wide grep finds the old string only at `src/ui/reports/index.ts:29`.

## Pin

`examples/app-showcase/test/report-description-measure.test.ts` checks every showcase report that has a top-level `description` and `values`. It reads the bound dataset's own declarations. It does not compare the subtitle against a copy of the expected text.

1. The description must name a bound measure by its declared `label`, which is the name the cell header shows. For a `count` measure, count words are also accepted.
2. The description may speak of counts only when a bound measure is a `count`.
3. An anti-vacuity check: the matrix must be among the graded reports.

Joined reports bind measures per block and have no top-level `values`, so the filter leaves them out. No test is skipped. The test reads its subject from source (`../src/ui/reports/index.js`), so no build sits between a mutation and the run.

**Ablation (one-off; no permanent file).** On the committed fix at `93d1e79c8d`, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put today's text back and ran the file:

- Mutation on disk: anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `28b7ce4486cc` to `1054fbd9a08b`.
- Red, as expected: `× showcase_status_priority_matrix: the description names a bound measure` and `× showcase_status_priority_matrix: the description claims no count its cells do not hold`, giving `Tests  2 failed | 5 passed (7)`.
- Restore proven: blob equals HEAD (`28b7ce4486cc`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Verification at `103c1b6e7d` (after merging `origin/main` `8133cc7805`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck` exits 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test file (1 hit).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` exits 0: `Test Files  34 passed (34)`, `Tests  422 passed (422)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 42 commands. All 42 exited 0 on this head. The `--ran` reconciliation reports `42 derived, 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, a derived zero with every exit code recorded. On the pre-merge head `93d1e79c8d`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3), because eight packages outside this diff had no `dist/`. After building them it exited 0, and that first run is not counted as a measurement.
- `test:repo` was not run locally. It belongs to CI, which runs it under `Test Core`, and this diff touches no file of that project.

## Scope and exclusions

- The dataset (`chart-gallery.dataset.ts`) and the renderer are not touched. Both are correct.
- There is no changeset: `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `"private": true` and publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- The pin checks report-level subtitles only. Block labels inside the joined report (`Open Tasks` binds `est_hours`, `Completed Tasks` binds `task_count`) name a population, not a quantity, so the pin does not grade them. This is a boundary note, not a defect claim.
